Giannis Antetokounmpo — Miami Heat
**Key Facts:**
- Trade: Milwaukee Bucks sent Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis to Miami Heat
- Heat sent: Tyler Herro, Kel'el Ware, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kasparas Jakucionis, three first-round picks (including No. 13 in 2026 draft), one second-round pick, one pick swap
- Giannis is a two-time MVP (back-to-back 2019, 2020)

- Extension eligibility: Giannis can sign extension starting October 1; expected to wait until January 6 (6 months post-trade) for maximum value
- Max extension available Jan 6: four-year, $275 million
- Alternative: opt in to $62.8M salary in 2027-28, then extend for three years and $214 million
- Championship odds before trade: Heat at 30-1; after trade: 18-1
- Giannis did not participate in Greece's FIBA World Cup qualifying window as he prepared for NBA season
